fields.biography: Leo Tolstoy was a Russian novelist regarded as one of the greatest authors of all time.
Fyodor Dostoevsky was a Russian novelist whose works explore human psychology in the troubled political, social, and spiritual atmosphere of 19th-century Russia.
George Orwell was an English novelist and essayist, journalist and critic, known for his clear writing and his opposition to totalitarianism.
Gabriel Garcia Marquez was a Colombian novelist and Nobel Prize winner, considered one of the most significant authors of the 20th century.
Haruki Murakami is a Japanese novelist whose work has been translated into 50 languages and sold millions of copies internationally.
